description: Return imported ad spend, cost models, completeness and spend freshness. Without from, to or cursor every row comes back at once; with any of them the rows are paged, ordered by network, campaign, ad set, ad and day, and next_cursor is null on the last page.

app_id.description: Optional app id to scope the result to one app.

cursor.description: Pass the next_cursor from the previous response to fetch the following page. Omit for the first page.

from.description: First metric day to include (UTC, YYYY-MM-DD). May be sent without to.

limit.description: Rows per page, 1-5000 (1000 when omitted). Read only in paged mode; alone it changes nothing.

to.description: Last metric day to include (UTC, YYYY-MM-DD). May be sent without from.

name: get_spend
title: Get spend and cost models
